data.pageText: mothScreen_924~Getting information by fooling people instead of computers. Typical tricks: calling as a [fakeCourier]fake courier[/fakeCourier], [phishing]phishing[/phishing] mails, and reading what people post about themselves until you can [doxxing]dox[/doxxing] them. Most data leaks begin with someone being polite to a stranger.

mothScreen_406~A fake message that looks like it comes from a bank or a social network ("Unusual login! Click here"). The link leads to a copy of the real page that steals the password. Spelling mistakes such as "metay0u" are a classic sign.

data.pageText: mothScreen_430~When a VPN sends your address questions ("where is metayou.com?") outside the tunnel. Anyone watching the network can see who you really are and roughly where you live. Works in both directions: a watcher's relay can leak too.

mothScreen_412~Collecting and publishing someone's private details (real name, home, workplace, phone). It is often paid for by people who are not allowed near the victim, such as someone with a [restrainingOrder]restraining order[/restrainingOrder]. Board users call it a "[bounty]bounty[/bounty]".

data.pageText: mothScreen_436~The movement of an animal towards (or away from) light. Moths circle street lamps and screens until they are exhausted. Some hackers choose the moth as a symbol; few of them read the end of the article.
mothScreen_934~Someone who uses other people's tools and tutorials without really understanding them. They are cheap to hire, and easy to trace: most of them are caught because of their own leaks.

mothScreen_758~Repeatedly following, watching or contacting someone against their will. Most victims know their stalker; many move house and hide their routines online. Hired "researchers" who find the new address are a growing problem.

mothScreen_2~Meow.

mothScreen_11~Forget firewalls. The weakest part of any system...
mothScreen_12~...is the human sitting in front of it.
mothScreen_13~This is called social engineering.

mothScreen_17~Like and subscribe. Stay invisible.

mothScreen_22~"Got a job for you. Find where she lives."

mothScreen_34~Mrrrrow.

mothScreen_38~Blue bike. She rides to work.
mothScreen_39~This is too easy. People are insane.
mothScreen_40~...I mean. Lucky for me.

mothScreen_43~F... L... U... F... F... Y.
